name: For the Peaceful Sleep
source:
The story began when a man visit to grave. He met a grave keeper Yua in midnight. Through they move together, the man tell a history about the grave. It's tragic and cruel fact. A girl who was sacrificed to the conflict. Finally, it's bring the truth Yua didn't know.

[From [url=http://www.braveesprit.com/english/soft.html]Brave Esprit[/url]]
translation:
故事从一名男子前往墓地开始。午夜时分，他遇见了守墓人尤阿。两人一同行动时，男子讲起了这座坟墓背后的往事。那是一个悲惨而残酷的事实：一个女孩成了冲突的牺牲品。最终，这段往事揭示了尤阿从未知道的真相。

[摘自[url=http://www.braveesprit.com/english/soft.html]Brave Esprit[/url]]
